1y3141r.567: A green area of about 480 hectares along the river Rio Vallone, a green lung in a very urbanized area, with rich flora and fauna (including 13 species of small mammals such as the wreath) and a cyclopedonal and horseback riding route that touches historical buildings such as the Sanctuary of Ornago and the lazzaretto of Cavenago di Brianza. It has seven entrances, one for each municipality, including Aicurzio; it borders the Molgora Park, the Adda Nord Park and the Montevecchia Park and the Curone Valley. It is also crossed by the regional bike route from Gessate to Carnate and Arcore.
r8ms2k.61: By bike or on foot through the woods and fields of Eastern Brianza.
r82gms.251: The village is crossed by the cyclendale of the parks of Rio Vallone and Molgora; in the village stands the late Baroque Villa Alfieri Perego, wanted by the canon Giovanni Perego, and the parish church of Sant'Ambrogio, built between 1924 and 1934.
sy2s1d.307: Late Baroque residence commissioned by the canon Giovanni Perego, humanist and art lover, as a place of holiday and family representation. It is located along the cycle path that crosses the square of Ronco Briantino and continues in the Park of Rio Molgora towards Carnate.
15o6w94.75: A late baroque villa of delight along the bike path of the Brianza parks.
1ygb5qx.490: Parish of the Diocese of Milan (decanated in Vimercate), built between 1924 and 1934, the year in which the frescoes and the interior flooring were executed; the presbytery had a structural intervention in 1974. The CEI card records in 1837 the church of Sant'Ambrogio in Nemus, today deconsecrated, and censisce inside the main altar and lateral altars, side chapels, frescoes, stained glass windows, statues, organ, source, tombstones and inscriptions; outside door, bell tower and parish church.
